grammar.semantics: Frozen transfer predicate; Fits must be available in scope.

grammar.name: Args

grammar.name: LetCase
grammar.semantics: Binder identity is an explicit payload of the head; scope is only PropBody.

grammar.name: Under
grammar.semantics: ASSERTED gives guard => body; POSSIBLE would put body inside possibility. Only ASSERTED is realized here.

grammar.name: LetArgs
grammar.semantics: Introduces aE or aB, depending on the fixed head. No cross-scope lifetime.

grammar.name: PostfixLetFrame
grammar.semantics: A universal postfix value-binding production. It takes the immediately preceding complete frame expression, never an arbitrary earlier frame.

grammar.name: SomeSupply
grammar.semantics: Head binds xE. The explicit final ref must resolve to xE; output exists xE: Fits(FrameOf(s),xE) AND SupplyApply(s,r,xE). Generic rule, presently only one complete use.

grammar.name: OrPhase
grammar.semantics: Explicit disjunction of the two phases.

grammar.name: FastingFrame
grammar.semantics: Fasting(OwnerOf(F),CaseOf(F)); explicit added generic projection construction, only attempted here.

grammar.name: Reference
grammar.signature: Ref<T> -> T-valued term in current binder environment
grammar.semantics: Unbound refs are gaps, not new constants. A BinderSyntax is never a Ref.
